title: "Wildlife Seen in the Duration of One Hour While Sitting in Manigault Park, Sewanee"

This project integrated the use of a shiny data entry app and pushed me out of my comfort zone. The goal of this project was to collect individual and personalized data. After much consideration, I decided to build an app that tracks the amount of wildlife seen while sitting for one hour in Manigault Park, Sewanee. I created five buttons that include all animals seen during the duration of one hour. These data variables include: (1) Birds, (2) Squirrels, (3) Dogs, (4) Flying Insects, (5) Crawling Insects. The results were unexpected yet exciting. (Results: 15 birds, 10 squirrels, 2 dogs, 11 flying insects, and 9 crawling insects.
